integrity: Exact spectra and rational exponential inequalities support all infinite-family claims; a standard-library checker corroborates integer matrix spectra and finite evaluations. No independent scientific validation is represented.
limitations: Two perfect leaders, unit-edge K_{2,q} with large part size at least nine. Finite-size winner certified at three exact times and nearby times; full finite-size phase diagram and limiting boundary ties not claimed. Theorems are mathematical and not independently audited.
title: Three finite-horizon optimal leader types on complete bipartite networks
